value.rationale: The maximal mutually orthogonal evaluation capacity is a natural, exact sampling-geometry invariant of a positive two-level Fock kernel family, and its discrete resonance set is not apparent from either Laguerre roots or abstract planar cardinality alone. The five-point possibility is rigid and isolated, and the full nonnegative weight spectrum is classified, including the disappearance of all orthogonal pairs above the critical weight. This is a complete nontrivial structural classification, rather than a small numerical gain.
